raw_text: Chinese warships at Hambantota again. This is becoming a regular pattern. The port is on a 99-year lease to China Merchants Port Holdings. How long before it becomes a de facto naval base? India must be watching this closely. The String of Pearls theory looking more real every year.
clean_text: Chinese warships at Hambantota port becoming regular. Port on 99-year Chinese lease. String of Pearls concerns growing.
